faq.title: About
faq.lead: Direct answers about the project, professional role and limits of clinical AI.
faq.q1: Who is Ulises Antonio Ponce Pretelin?
faq.a1: Ulises Antonio Ponce Pretelin is a physical therapist and clinical AI engineer in Xalapa, Veracruz, Mexico. He created PoncePretelin and combines clinical experience with clinical record systems built on referenced evidence.
faq.a2: PoncePretelin is a clinical manager with optional AI for physical therapy: multi-specialty records, episodes, live SOAP notes, scheduling with public booking, clinical libraries with referenced values and openFDA and RxNav safety integrations.
faq.a3: No. PoncePretelin is not a generic empty-form EMR. It is designed for physical therapy with clinical automations, IASP/WHO ICF terminology, EBP scales and traceable evidence in diagnostic tests.
faq.q4: Does PoncePretelin use AI to diagnose?
faq.a4: It does not replace professional judgment. AI modules support imaging and clinical assistance with explicit legal notices; clinical decisions remain with the physical therapist.
faq.q5: What clinical safety integrations does it include?
faq.a5: It integrates openFDA for device alerts and recalls, and RxNav for medication context in clinical intake, as a validation layer within the consultation workflow.
faq.a6: It focuses on physical therapy and rehabilitation, with multi-specialty support, SOAP templates by clinic and workflows for first visit, EBP follow-up and prudent clinical terminology.
